title: Fast Break-Time Variance
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`faith:rosary`), retreat events (`faith:retreat`), attendance logs (`faith:attendance`), fasting journals (`faith:fast`), practice reviews (`faith:ops`).
app: Spiritual-practice telemetry — rosary counters, meditation-retreat schedules, church-attendance logs, and fasting journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=faith:fast fast_type=* break_time_variance_min=*
| stats avg(break_time_variance_min) as avg_break_time_variance_min, count as events by fast_type
| sort - avg_break_time_variance_min
description: Shows average break-time variance minutes by fast type for fast completion timing.
value: Average break-time variance minutes by fast type helps compare fast completion timing across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `break_time_variance_min` on `faith:fast` events and normalize `fast_type` so Splunk can summarize performance by fast type.
visualization: Bar chart of average break-time variance minutes by fast type.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals the average break-time variance minutes for each fast type so you can see what works best for fast completion timing.
